# shc_snapshot (Resource)

Manages a snapshot of an SHC VPS.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (String) The SHC service ID of the VPS to snapshot.

### Optional

- `name` (String) A name for the snapshot.
- `restore` (Boolean) When true, triggers a one-shot restore of the VM from this snapshot on the next apply. Resets to false after the restore completes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The snapshot ID.
- `snapshot_id` (String) The ID of the created snapshot.
- `status` (String) The status of the snapshot.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "shc_vm" "db" {
  hostname = "database"
  size     = "nvme-2c-8gb"
  template = "debian13-cloud"
}

resource "shc_snapshot" "pre_deploy" {
  service_id = shc_vm.db.service_id
  name       = "pre-deploy-checkpoint"
}
```
